history_status: ALL_PREVIOUSLY_SEEN_DEVELOPMENT; modern AI and repeated feedback cannot create independent historical evidence
engine: unchanged research.phase2_v2.engine.evaluate; exact frozen source binding

discovery.rule_grid: existing 66 declarative rules; only historically prior-cutoff outbox roots
discovery.event: per-asset false-to-true onset after eligible prior/current bars; an event ends at first onset+horizon, never extends transitively; cross-asset onsets inside that FIXED interval share one bounded episode
discovery.independence: episodes are occurrence units, NOT statistically independent samples; simultaneous assets never multiply inferential n
discovery.frequency_uncertainty: 30-day moving calendar blocks jointly resample counts and eligibility; fewer than 20 episodes => null/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
discovery.association: event aftermath descriptive only; no independent association PASS from frequency

statistics.primary_endpoint: positive median common-calendar block log-growth difference between costed Phase2 candidate and BTC_HALF; portfolio aggregates all assets before inference
statistics.test: exact one-sided binomial sign test, ties excluded; no Monte Carlo p floor
statistics.null_assumption: conditional on prior training selection, independent fair block signs; within-block and cross-asset dependence unrestricted; 14-day gaps limit label overlap but do NOT establish independence of financial regimes
statistics.alpha: 0.05/[t*(t+1)]; inherit 1428 conservative legacy attempts; one new alpha reservation per candidate primary endpoint, including invalid/uninformative attempts; backtest calls counted separately and never advertised as statistical tests
statistics.claim: conditional-null development diagnostic ONLY; historical sign independence and modern-LLM contamination remain unverified; no confirmed trading candidate

evolution.gene_dedup: global normalized genes across legacy continuous v1, completed v2 and all successor cycles; no new progress for a previously evaluated gene
evolution.family_bridge: M/L/N/J outbox mechanisms can propose correlation-aware K genes inside the ALREADY authorized K space; explicit mechanism-inspired bridge, never equivalence to anomaly rule
evolution.authorized_pool: freeze at deployment at most 16 previously unseen K genes paired with distinct bounded-onset hypotheses and valid prior-cutoff outbox roots; no hidden widening or paid new AI
evolution.successors: after both candidate receipts/feedback complete, freeze next two unused pool entries; order uses ONLY prior-training metrics/failures, with previous feedback hashes and lineage; never use test score for mutation selection
evolution.scoring: training, nominal continuous test, 2x costs and delayed-entry test through unchanged engine; candidate failure terminal for that candidate only
evolution.idle: IDLE_NO_NEW_WORK when the frozen authorized 16-entry pool is exhausted; disclose remaining wider K space, never claim all global research is exhausted

data_policy.identity: all unresolved @ identity segments quarantined prospectively by frozen universe restriction; do not splice original/new LUNA, do not call this certified point-in-time completeness
data_policy.halt: daily engine cannot price an intraday halt/exit; missing held price invalidates entire candidate book, no invented exit, stale mark or CASH reset
data_policy.luna: official USDT minute archive/checksum can prove observations 00:00-00:39 on 2022-05-13; it does not restore a full daily candle or certify 00:29 executable exit. Original frozen result stays UNDEFINED_INVALID
data_policy.quality: positive valid OHLCV and 61 contiguous bars for eligibility; no gap filling; trading a bad candle invalidates candidate; separate candidate receipts preserve unrelated work
data_policy.venue: historical spot proxy; exact publication latency/depth/slippage unavailable; no derivatives inferred

freeze: contract, code, input manifest, inherited counters, all historical seen-gene hashes, pool, endpoint/window/null/power before any new results; each batch separately hash-frozen before discovery/evolution evaluations
